Name: Multiple Spouse Dialogs - Seb and Alex Rarepair (EXPLICIT)
Author: rkarko
Description:
Additional explicit dialogue for my mod Multiple Spouse Dialogs - Seb & Alex Rarepair. Features Seb's dirty mouth and Alex spluttering and occasionally showing his own sass. 

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]20+ Call & Response brief chat bubbles dialogue
[*]Characterization: DomSeb/SubAlex, TopSeb/BottomAlex is the general vibe, both cis-men. 
[*]Includes some Festival chats
[/list]
[b][size=5]Instructions:[/size][/b]
1. "Extract All" into Mod folder for Stardew Valley.
2.  Move "dialog-seb.alex.Explicit" file to ceruleandeep's Multiple Spouse Dialogs folder > assets.
3. Alternatively, you can "Extract All" directly to ceruleandeep's Multiple Spouse Dialogs folder > assets.

[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-235#post-138263http://]AnotherPillow's 1.6 update[/url]﻿ of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8711?tab=descriptionhttp://]ceruleandeep's Multiple Spouse Dialogs[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599http://]Polyamory﻿Sweet by AprllForever[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI by Pathoschild[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿ by Pathoschild[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30881]Multiple Spouse Dialogs - Seb and Alex Rarepair by rkarko[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Highly Recommend: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098http://]Generic Mod Config Menu by spacechase0[/url] to configure the base Multiple Spouse Dialogs mod﻿
[/list]
[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]After moving dialog file, SMAPI may report that the mod was not installed because "no content.json", this is normal & still works
[*]Example pics feature[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley (DSV) by AirynS[/url][b]﻿[/b], configured "true" for Alex Variant. No chats specifically align with Alex Variant dialogues and are mostly canon.
[*]See [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30881?tab=description]Main Mod[/url]﻿[/b] for additional notes
[/list]
